items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Ray Nance had died until somebody called me

ctx.x: You know, I mean that service for Ray Nance, did you go to that?

I missed Ray Nance -- you know, I didn't know Ray Nance had died until somebody called me on the contemplating Milt Hinton phone, and I was (unintelligible) and this regular Chicago bunch from the south side. The fellow in Denmark said, Hap, all those they get out-of Chicago's together. I said, yeah, I says, and I thought it was -- was whatchacallum.
Well, that funeral service went on for over two hours.
